name: Therapeutic Sciences PhD

applicationFee.note: Needs-based request in Additional Information with hardship explanation and accepted financial-aid, FAFSA, CSS, recent unemployment or GRE/TOEFL reduction-voucher documentation. Recommended at least two weeks early; only listed documents accepted. International applicants must confirm documentation eligibility; no overseas eligibility guarantee.

english.toefl: 90 before January 21, 2026; 4.5 on or after January 21, 2026
english.note: IELTS 7 is recommended, not a hard university cutoff. Home Edition and IELTS Indicator accepted. Degree from US/listed countries or non-US institution where English is primary instruction can exempt; other-country degrees need Registrar/Dean letter confirming language for program/institution. US studies primarily in another language do not exempt. TA English certification separate.

documents: College transcripts; certified English translations when needed; unofficial review copies and final official record before matriculation
Three online recommendations; at least two from faculty at current/most recent institution; Interfolio not accepted
requirements.note: General and subject GRE not considered. Statement addresses why PhD/this program, prior research and independent contribution, and obstacles overcome. Program FAQ requires submission at least 14 days before deadline for fee-waiver consideration; central policy calls two weeks recommended. Laboratory rotations discussed in curriculum, but exact admissions route not established.

detailsNote: Current deadline confirmed in official 2026 application explorer. Department annual December 1 and older central-style funding wording are qualified; admission model not established by accessible instructions.

deadlines.label: Application deadline
deadlines.note: Application explorer gives 12/01/2026; all deadlines 11:59 PM Eastern.

funding.note: Program accepts PhDs with full tuition, stipend and health-insurance fees, guaranteed five years subject to satisfactory progress. First 18 months University fellowship; later TA/RA or external grants. Central guarantee applies to domestic/foreign students; transfer support may vary. No current stipend amount established.

timeline.interviews: Program says January recruitment annually; FAQ describes invitations in late December and decisions after interview.
